## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 17, 2026 - Aug 20, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Joshua Adams_, Aug 20, 2026, 1/5: "lagging app, even worse payment method. why the hell do I have to put my routing and account number into a gym app. youd have more access to my bank information than my landlord at that point"
            2. _Samansa_, Aug 17, 2026, 2/5: "Planet Fitness has some great equipment and lots of perks. However.. it is very expensive and when I tried to cancel my membership after my mother passed away and I had to move an hour away, they told me I have to write a letter and mail it in or visit my home branch (now an hour drive away) to cancel in person. This is unacceptable and false advertising. When I got my membership I was told I can cancel anytime with ease. Disappointed! App needs work too by the way."
<!--/ir-theme-->
